result_policy: No result is claimed until all test shards pass integrity checks.
research_question: Within the geometry-feasible pose set, does a frozen policy exhibit a policy-specific success basin, and is there measurable headroom between the strongest geometry-only pose and a sampled empirical policy oracle?

main_definitions.p_train: Audited demonstration SE(2) medoid. Used as a policy-familiarity reference, not as the definition of the optimum.
main_definitions.p_geom: Highest preregistered geometry-only score among geometry-feasible sampled candidates; selected without policy outcomes.
main_definitions.p_oracle: Highest empirical phase-2 policy success rate among the sampled geometry-feasible basin candidates.
main_definitions.H_geom: S_val(p_oracle) - S_val(p_geom), measured with independent phase-3 paired validation seeds.
main_definitions.H_train: S_val(p_oracle) - S_val(p_train), measured with independent phase-3 paired validation seeds.
main_definitions.empirical_basin: Sampled geometry-feasible poses whose empirical phase-2 policy success rate is at least 0.80.

geometry_score.weights_source: fixed before test evaluation; any tuning is calibration-split only
geometry_score.normalization: per-scene min-max over P_e, equal weight

diagnostics_and_robustness.p_train: Training-demonstration pose; candidate-generation prior and sanity check only.
diagnostics_and_robustness.simulator_default: Metadata only; used as p_train proxy only under an explicit debug flag.
diagnostics_and_robustness.S_geom_plus: Post-hoc maximum validation SR among p_geom and all geometry ablations.
diagnostics_and_robustness.H_geom_plus: S_val(p_oracle) - S_geom_plus; robustness result, not the Gate-A primary metric.

candidate_protocol.room_wide_generation: 0.10 m floor grid with seven target-facing headings; no fixed annulus

rollout_protocol.promotion: top 3 plus every candidate within 0.20 success rate of the search best

inference.bootstrap: resample policy seeds, scenes within policy seed, then paired validation seeds
